title.narrative: PERFORMANCE-BASED PARTNERSHIP SCHEME FOCUSING ON QUALITY PROGRAMMING, UNDERSTANDING CHANGE AND RESULTS FOR POOR HOUSEHOLDS AND COMMUNITIES

description.narrative: The Multisectoral Emergency Response & Resilience Building of IDP and Host Communities in Gogrial East and Tonj North Counties, Warrap State programme implemented by Trócaire aims to contribute to Outcome 4.2: The most vulnerable/marginalised women, men, girls and boys in the communities affected by crisis can meet their basic needs. The activities and objective include, the provision of seeds and tools, training for farmers and women’s groups, women have access VSLAs and are trained in business skills, so they are able to protect, revitalise and restore their livelihoods. Programmes are in partnership with, The Organization for Children's Harmony (TOCH) and Hope Agency for Relief and Development (HARD). ---- The principal focus of this objective is:- Promote sustainable, resilient approaches to agriculture i.e. the adoption of agroecological practices- Management of natural resources to protect local biodiversity- Improve access to more diversified nutritional diets and food and improve the nutritional status of a target population- reduce poverty at a household level for the most marginalised of a community- Reduce social, economic or political power inequalities between women and men, girls and boys- Building resilience to climate change involves applying strategies that are directly related to climate adaptation - agroecology, protecting natural resources and poverty reduction are part of this as they support individuals, households and communities to adapt to climate change impacts so they are better able to cope.Capacity strengthening of communities is a core element of the approach
